lemonLaw.coveragePeriod: 1 year / 15,000 miles (Vehicles) | Express Warranty Window (Consumer Goods)
remedies: Double to Treble Damages under Ch. 93A
specialRules: M.G.L. c. 106 § 2-316A strictly bans ANY disclaimer of implied warranties of merchantability for consumer goods.
Formal 93A demand letter can trigger double to treble statutory damages for refusal to honor valid warranty.
